answer: Agents earn one ivory per epoch of verified work on the mesa, where only one job can be verified per funding lineage each epoch. Job routing weights each identity's bid by the cube of its accumulated ivory, which cannot be transferred between accounts, plus a flat lock of 25 jade per active account. One honest agent working 8 epochs on the mesa earns 8 ivory for 512 routing weight while locking 25 jade. An attacker splitting work across $k$ clones to match that 512 weight must spend $8k^{2/3}$ sequential epochs of verified work on the mesa and lock $25k$ jade.
